value.rationale: The polynomial-image quotient-set denseness criterion is an explicit 2018 open direction. This exact natural degree-four, odd-coefficient classification determines entire local closures and realizes three distinct maximal proper open index-two subgroups (unit sign, valuation parity, their product), rather than a basic non-density obstruction. It distinguishes three nonsplitting branches with different topological structures; c=7 is included for completeness as prior-covered.
